comments.snippet:
Thanks for letting the auto-report through. The crash signatures land on old builds:

- `System.Runtime.InteropServices.InvalidComObjectException: COM object ... separated from its underlying RCW` — the lifetime management on the RDP ActiveX client was reworked on `main` after the build you're on.
- `System.NullReferenceException` in `frmMain` / tree selection — the code paths that produced those NREs were replaced as part of the focus-handling work.
